title: Juicy Mediterranean Baby Plum Tomato Skewers
description: A briny and pillowy crowd-pleaser Mediterranean dish featuring baby plum tomatoes, render-fat, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, served on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, duck fat, oregano, thyme, garlic, lemon zest, salt, and pepper.
Add the halved baby plum tomatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated tomatoes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each tomato.
Place the skewers on a cedar plank and grill for 10-12 minutes, or until the tomatoes are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the tomato skewers warm, garnished with additional oregano and thyme if desired.
